scope: This artifact records inferential limits of the frozen v2 synthetic qualification protocol before candidate development, calibration, locked evaluation, or generalization outcomes are inspected.

frozen_cadence_panel.finding: Development, calibration, and locked evaluation reuse the same frozen cadence geometries. Independent phase seeds create independent stochastic trial streams, but they do not create an independent sample of cadence geometries.
frozen_cadence_panel.estimand_boundary: Primary v2 qualification is therefore conditional on the frozen 25-cadence synthetic panel and the prespecified nuisance envelope. It is not an estimate of performance averaged over an arbitrary survey-cadence population.
prohibited_extrapolations: Do not describe a successful v2 qualification as real-sky completeness.
Do not describe it as population-level generalization over arbitrary survey cadence distributions.
Do not treat phase-independent noise or signal streams as independent cadence sampling.
Do not convert a synthetic-panel result into an operational survey claim without a separately specified external-cadence validation study.

paired_cadence_bootstrap.interpretation: The prespecified paired bootstrap over the 25 frozen cadence realizations is useful for sensitivity/variability across this panel. Because the cadence panel is frozen from a synthetic generator rather than defined here as an iid probability sample from a target survey-cadence population, the interval must not be presented as a population confidence interval for arbitrary real survey cadences.
paired_cadence_bootstrap.protocol_integrity: This audit does not alter the frozen bootstrap rule, threshold, promotion criterion, seed, cadence, or trial count. It only constrains the scientific claim attached to that statistic.

confidence_gate_audit.finding: With 5000 locked null trials per regime, the prespecified point-FPR cap of 1% implies at most 50 false alarms. At that count the prespecified Wilson 95% upper bound is below 1.5%, so the Wilson gate is non-binding whenever the stricter point-FPR gate passes.
confidence_gate_audit.interpretation: Retain both frozen gates for protocol integrity, but do not describe the Wilson condition as an independent rejection barrier in the v2 study.
confidence_gate_audit.future_protocol_rule: If a future study intends a confidence-bound gate to add independent protection, jointly choose trial count, point cap, and confidence-bound threshold so that the confidence gate can bind in a nonempty region.

allowed_if_supported_by_frozen_results: Synthetic qualification under the prespecified finite nuisance envelope.
Conditional performance across the frozen 25-cadence panel.
Failure or success against the exact preregistered promotion gates.
Negative or mixed results without post-hoc gate revision.
not_established_by_v2_alone: Robustness to nuisance processes outside the prespecified envelope.
Generalization to arbitrary or target-survey cadence distributions.
Operational discovery yield on a named survey.
Population-level uncertainty over real survey cadence geometries.

strongest_defensible_extension_after_v2.name: external_cadence_validation
strongest_defensible_extension_after_v2.timing: separate preregistration after the frozen v2 study is completed; do not append it post hoc to v2
design_requirements: Define a target cadence population before outcomes are inspected.
Use an independent set of cadence geometries not reused in v2 development or calibration.
Prefer actual survey cadence traces when the scientific target is a named survey; otherwise specify a generative cadence distribution whose parameters are justified independently of v2 outcomes.
Freeze the sampling frame, inclusion/exclusion rules, sample size, seeds, and primary estimand before evaluation.
Carry the v2-selected method and threshold forward without retuning on the external cadence set unless a new study explicitly defines and separates a calibration subset.
Report conditional v2 qualification and external-cadence validation as distinct evidence layers.

non_modification_statement: No scientific parameter, candidate, threshold, seed, cadence, trial identity, trial count, promotion criterion, or frozen outcome-access rule is modified by this audit.
